compiled_state.title: The brainstorm process missed the impact of PR merge strategy changes on local merge strategy workflows

comments.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: same root cause as f713-996c-e837-4be6 — brainstorm cross-resource scan did not check PR merge strategy changes against local-workflow compatibility. The fix is the same workflow-trigger-filter audit addition to brainstorm SKILL.md Step 2.27, extended to also flag when merge.strategy / dso.workflow changes (local↔ci-pr) could affect which workflows fire on pushes/PRs. Classification: MODERATE. Linked to f713; recommend fixing both in a single commit. Not addressed in this P2 pass; leaving OPEN.
